fields.summary: Add whitespace normalization to the label slug helper

content.text: Feature request: trim labels and turn internal whitespace runs into hyphens while preserving lowercase behavior. Confirm punctuation handling with the customer. See attached requirements. No UI or browser work.
Compatibility detail: labels may contain underscores and punctuation. Their handling must be confirmed with the customer, rather than inferred from common URL-slug conventions.

Planning note 2: this is a new whitespace-normalization feature for the existing label helper. Keep the public API, lowercase behavior and dependency-free implementation. No browser integration, server, migration, telemetry or publication is part of this ticket.
